text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic female character, preserve apparent age. Warm brown long hair with honey strands, hazel eyes, softly rounded oval face. golden-brown loose waves, heather-gray fine-knit crewneck, small silver oval pendant. One centered chest-up studio ID portrait. Straight front view, eye-level camera, upright head, level shoulders, eyes looking directly at the camera, relaxed neutral closed-mouth expression. Consistent 3:4 portrait crop, full hair visible, pure white background, soft even studio lighting, realistic skin texture. Preserve a consistent individual face and hairstyle across all views. High-detail photographic skin, anatomically natural features, no watermarks, interfaces, logos or text.
original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Input image is the edit target. Rephotograph this exact individual with a rigorously straight-on frontal eye-level camera. Correct the residual oblique face and skewed facial features. Head and shoulders square to lens, zero yaw, roll and pitch; both pupils precisely on the same horizontal line looking at camera. Forehead center, nose bridge, nose tip, philtrum, mouth center and chin aligned on the image vertical centerline. Equal perspective on cheeks, eyes and nostrils, level shoulders. Preserve identity and natural facial detail; do not create a mirrored artificial face. Must look like a genuine frontal ID portrait rather than the previous subtly turned face. Preserve the same person, apparent age, hairstyle and color, clothing, jewelry, eye color, natural skin tone and texture. Preserve the centered chest-up portrait scale and consistent bright even soft frontal studio lighting, pure white background. Maintain strict frontal eye-level pose. Output one photorealistic portrait, 3:4 vertical 1086x1448, no text, watermark, collage or frame. Outside the requested correction, preserve the reference as closely as possible.
reproduction_note: 独立文生图提示词按本次角色外观与成图重建；实际生成采用已确认肖像作为图像参考，原始编辑提示词另保留。独立文生图不能保证逐像素复现。
